content: MK reports (from Bashir and Manz) that Aḥmad Samarqandī, sometime chief disciple of Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī, was disowned, declared an unbeliever and persecuted by Khwāfī when he would not stop teaching the Fuṣūṣ or reciting the verses of Qāsim-i Anvār; Ṣāʾin al-Dīn had sent him a copy of his Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr.
refers_to_primary: Bashir, Sufi Bodies, 99, 191; Manz, Power (via MK)
